record.field: Supplies - count stock and review manual replenishment

field.name: note
field.p: Count Dental Supplies and reconcile differences through Inventory. Masks, suction tips and pouches are below the minimum. Review RFQ SUP-2026-0041 before ordering again, using the configured pack sizes and vendor lead times.
Launch the Weekly supply check plan on products for the next review and choose the responsible staff member. No supplies are consumed automatically from appointments.

record.field: Supplies - review batch CR-251205B before expiry

field.name: note
field.p: Compare the expiration and alert dates with the package label. Review the remaining stock, approved handling procedure and replacement needs with the supply coordinator.

record.field: Purchases - match received packs and review the draft vendor bill

field.name: note
field.p: Open the completed receipt and linked draft bill. Compare ordered packs, received quantities, vendor reference, prices and applicable taxes. Review before selecting Confirm, then arrange payment through the supplier-payment process.

field.name: note
field.p: Confirm the administrative delivery date with the laboratory and reception before arranging the next visit. The purchase line is due in seven days. On delivery, record the service's received quantity and review any matching vendor bill. Keep clinical instructions in the practice's approved clinical process.
